verdict.rationale: Devin exposes a public API (devin-docs-8, devin-docs-9) that lets you programmatically create sessions on behalf of users, and an official CLI (devin-probe-4) that could in principle be scripted, but there is no explicit documentation or example showing Devin running headlessly inside a CI/CD pipeline or shell script (e.g., no GitHub Actions integration, no non-interactive/headless flag mentioned). missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples, headless/non-interactive CLI mode documentation, evidence of exit codes/scripting patterns for automated pipelines.
